# My Love Pattern

> Identify the love pattern shaping your relationships and learn what actually shifts it. Free 60-second quiz, in-depth pattern guides, and a self-paced reset course by Signe Putna.

My Love Pattern helps people recognise the four core love patterns (The Over-Investor, The Unavailable Chaser, The Validator Seeker, The Boundary Softener), understand where they come from, and break the cycle through honest writing, tools, and a guided reset.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Free 60-second quiz to discover your love pattern.
- [About](/about): Signe Putna and the story behind My Love Pattern.
- [Blog](/blog): Essays on love patterns, self-worth, dating, and healthy relationships.

## Pattern guides

- [The Over-Investor](/the-over-investor): Why you give everything before anything is real.
- [The Unavailable Chaser](/the-unavailable-chaser): Why distance feels like chemistry.
- [The Validator Seeker](/the-validator-seeker): Why one unanswered text wrecks you.
- [The Boundary Softener](/the-boundary-softener): Why you lose your boundaries when you like someone.
